name: flow_builders_tip_follows_the_builder
description: On the Builders screen the tower card follows the Builder shown (playtest halv s1, shots 0006 to 0008: hovering W on the Lamplighter's card and pressing 2, 3 and 4 kept 'Cannon Tower (W)' open over the Lookout's, the Bellfounder's and the Beekeeper's kits). With the pointer on W, picking another Builder shows that Builder's own tower on W, its card the in-game card's body; with no card open, picking one opens none, and Q W E open the new Builder's.

steps.msg: the Builders screen on the Lamplighter, no card open
W's card: the Lamplighter's Cannon Tower

steps.assert: node('BuildersScreen').selected == 'lookout' and node('TowerTip').visible and node('TowerTipBody').text == lookout_w['body']
steps.msg: 2: the Lookout, and W's card says what her tower on W does
under her tower's name and price, not the Cannon Tower's
the pointer off the card: no card
picking a Builder with no card open opens none
E opens the Lamplighter's tower on E
and follows to the Lookout's on E
